read.title: Payment Terms for Your First Order
read.text:
Dear Mr. Haddad,

Thank you for confirming your first order of our cica toner. For new partners, our payment terms are a 30% deposit by wire transfer when the order is confirmed, and the balance before shipment.

Production will begin as soon as we receive the deposit. Payment of the balance is due upon receipt of the final invoice, which we will send once the goods are packed.

After three successful orders, we are willing to discuss more flexible terms.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee

write.en: Reply to a new buyer explaining the deposit, when the balance is due, and how to pay.
write.model:
Dear Ms. Novak,

Thank you for your question. For first orders, we ask for a 30% deposit by wire transfer when you confirm the order. The balance is due upon receipt of the final invoice, before shipment. We are willing to review these terms after a few orders.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
